about: Fortnite-style HUD over Minecraft (polished per creator request). scale: each panel is drawn at this size around its anchor (so the bottom panels never overlap the hotbar). anchor: screen corner; x/y: offset in GUI pixels from it; size: width (or diameter) in GUI pixels. 'when': hub, match or always.

rows.shows: terrain map (north up, no letters: the compass bar shows direction); smooth anti-aliased storm area (purple), black storm edge and next circle, dashed black path to the safe zone, smooth yellow arrow with a dark outline, all drawn in real screen pixels

one Fortnite-style row under the map, joined to the minimap frame with no gap, exactly its width (size = minimap size): storm icon + phase timer, person icon + players left, crosshair icon + your eliminations
'STORM EYE SHRINKING' / 'STORM EYE SHRINKS IN m:ss' banner for the first seconds of each phase
shield bar (blue) above health bar (green) with icons and numbers, Fortnite style
held gun: rarity-coloured name plate, big ammo / magazine, RELOADING bar
Fortnite materials row: Wood / Brick / Metal counts with coloured icons, above the ammo panel
'PRESS SPACE TO JUMP' while riding the Battle Bus; 'SKYDIVING' / 'GLIDER DEPLOYED' + height while dropping
what to do in the hub (portal, obby, B for emotes) and how many are on the portal
team modes: each teammate's name in their colour with their shield and health bars; KNOCKED with the bleed-out time, or the reboot card's time left, or OUT
'Hold F to revive <name>' / 'Hold F to reboot <names>' near a knocked teammate or a reboot van, and the progress bar while held; 'KNOCKED - bleeding out' with the time left while you are down
your party (names in their teammate colours) under the hub banner; /party invite <name> to start one

small Fortnite-style crosshair drawn in real screen pixels (size = line length in screen px, 2 px thick), 4 lines around a dot; the gap follows the held gun's spread and tightens while aiming; just a dot without a gun
Minecraft hotbar shrunk to Fortnite size (pickaxe + 5 item slots, 3 locked), anchored to the bottom centre; no XP bar
chat locked (creator): text size 70% (scale), width 200 px (size); every chat slider in Chat Settings is greyed out
Minecraft GUI Scale locked at this value (3); its button in Video Settings is greyed out
field of view locked at this value (60); the FOV slider is greyed out
Fortnite compass bar: N/NE/E... letters and 15-degree ticks slide past as you turn; the direction you face is under the centre marker
Tab: the whole island as one picture made by the server, almost full screen with a margin; A-J / 1-10 grid, storm, black rings, you, your red waypoint
your own waypoint: red beacon beam in the world, red mark on the compass bar, on-screen red diamond with the distance in metres; in team modes your teammates see it in your colour (Solo: private)
strong purple screen tint + vignette while you are outside the circle
